From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call follow-up: deployment path, evidence & next steps (HealthWave)

Thanks Amit and Sara — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we keep momentum: 

Call summary (high level)
- HealthWave use case: clinical note ingestion + semantic search over PHI; must meet HIPAA requirements and sign a BAA.
- Hosting consideration: you indicated preference for either Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool) or Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) depending on audit requirements. Hosted API is acceptable only if we can provide stronger isolation + BAA + SOC2 evidence — we discussed constraints.

Agreed next steps (from our side and yours)
1) HealthWave to confirm by 2026-09-15 whether Dedicated or Private is preferred (timeline for production: target Q4).
2) HealthWave to send the security section of your RFP / any high-priority questions (you mentioned the RFP security PDF).
3) Redwood to provide: short evidence pack (SOC2 summary + types of artifacts), BAA draft, and a technical deep-dive on VPC peering / dedicated-network options.
4) Schedule technical deep-dive w/ infra engineers — suggested: Wed Aug 19 11:00am PT.

Attachments: post-call-summary.pdf (high level), Redwood_Security_OnePager.pdf (security highlights).

Open questions for you: 
- Can you confirm whether the PHI processing will be wholly within US regions?
- Do you require customer-managed keys (BYOK) or will KMS/HSM managed by us suffice?

I'll coordinate internal owners on the evidence checklist and draft a BAA for initial review. If either of you want a different time for the deep-dive, tell me and I'll adjust.

Thanks again,
Ben

Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call follow-up: deployment path, evidence & next steps (HealthWave)

Thanks Ben — useful recap. A couple of clarifications from our security team after the call: 

1) Contractual: We must execute a BAA before any PHI-containing workload goes live.
2) Audit evidence: SOC 2 Type II report (most recent), pen-test summary, and encryption/key-management details are required for vendor approval.
3) Deployment preference: Security leadership wants Private (customer VPC with full control) as the preferred option. Dedicated (single-tenant within Redwood but with VPC peering) is acceptable if we can verify network isolation, key control, and audit log retention policy. Hosted API is a last resort and would need explicit exceptions and technical compensating controls.
4) Timeline: We need vendor selection sign-off by 2026-09-15; can you confirm whether Redwood can provide SOC2 artifacts and a BAA template within 3–5 business days?

Sending the security portion of the RFP now — attaching the relevant PDF.

Thanks,
Amit Patel
Head of Infrastructure Security, HealthWave
amit@healthwave.com

Subject: Re: Post-call follow-up: deployment path, evidence & next steps (HealthWave)

Amit — appreciate the clarity and the RFP extract. Short answers and ownership below. I'll schedule the deep-dive for Wed Aug 19 11:00am PT and send an invite once internal confirm.

Quick answers to your asks: 
- BAA: Yes — we'll share a draft by EOD tomorrow (Marissa will lead).
- SOC2: We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report summary and control matrix; full report typically requires an NDA/processing agreement but we can provide the auditor's letter and control summaries within 3 business days. (Marissa: can you confirm artifacts + minimal gating docs?)
- Pen test: We have a recent penetration test executive summary; full findings can be shared with a redaction process or under an NDA.
- Key management: Two options: 
   a) Dedicated — Redwood-managed KMS with tenant isolation and customer KMS keys in dedicated deployments; offers strong separation and integrated audit logs.
   b) Private (VPC/on-prem) — supports BYOK where HealthWave controls the keys; recommended if you need complete control of key lifecycle.
- VPC peering & network isolation: Dedicated supports dedicated GPU pools + VPC peering, private IP routing, and restricted egress by policy. Private offers fully customer-managed networking.

Internal owners & asks (assignments):
- Marissa Cole: prepare BAA draft, SOC2 artifact list, and pen-test summary to share. Deliverable: BAA_draft_HealthWave_v1.docx + list of artifacts. (owner: Marissa)
- Karthik Iyer: confirm exact VPC peering setup steps, NAT/eBPF egress controls, and estimated time for a dedicated deployment on our infra. (owner: Karthik)

Attachments: Redwood_Security_OnePager.pdf (security posture + available artifacts).

Amit — we'll aim to get the BAA draft + SOC2 summary into your hands by Wed EOD (3 business days). If you need anything sooner (e.g., a redacted SOC2), tell Marissa directly.

Regards,
Ben
